alkylation reagent: Carbamidomethyl of cysteine was specified as a fixed modification
cleavage agent: A reverse-phase trapping column (0.3 mm inner diameter x 1 mm) containing 5 μm C18 300 Å Acclaim PepMap medium (Dionex) was loaded with the tryptic peptides at high flow rate.
enrichment method: Samples were enriched via a GFP-trap, and eluted material was subjected to SDS-PAGE and immunoblotting.
instrument: Liquid chromatography/tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS) was carried out using an LTQ Orbitrap mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
labeling: no labeling strategy mentioned for sample-linked proteomics runs
reduction reagent: A volume of 30 μl 2 × SDS-PAGE sample buffer (125 mM Tris-HCl, 200 mM dithiothreitol, 4% (w/v) SDS, 20% (v/v) glycerol, and 0.05% (w/v) bromophenol blue, pH 6.8) was added
reduction concentration: A volume of 30 μl 2 × SDS-PAGE sample buffer (125 mM Tris-HCl, 200 mM dithiothreitol, 4% (w/v) SDS, 20% (v/v) glycerol, and 0.05% (w/v) bromophenol blue, pH 6.8) was added
